Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the task was effectively resolved in Step 3. In Step 3, WebSurfer provided definitive, authoritative confirmation (Wikipedia and Latitude.to) of the primary location (San Luis Obispo) and its coordinates, while also noting the lack of evidence for other locations. Despite this, the Planner in Step 4 incorrectly concluded that "No solid confirmation yet of additional California Bubblegum Alley locations" existed and continued to issue redundant instructions to search for "additional" locations and "reconfirm" coordinates that were already verified. This demonstrates a failure to consolidate results and a logical error in assessing the sufficiency of the gathered data, leading to an unnecessary and repetitive search loop.
